name: Helicopter
instructions: omr/instructions/9396-1-1.pdf, 9396-1-3.pdf, 9396-1-2.pdf (the books are numbered 1, 3, 2 on their covers: 9396-1-3.pdf is book 2 and 9396-1-2.pdf is book 3; function page: 9396-1-2.pdf page 45; pages 46-57 of that book are the optional Power Functions add-on, 8293, which the model file doesn't include)

functions.does: One knob on the fuselage's side works everything through a gearbox; two selector levers, one on each side, each slide a driving ring between two gears. With one lever toward the rotor symbol, turning the knob spins the main rotor and, through a long shaft down the tail boom, the tail rotor.
functions.source: book 3 (9396-1-2.pdf) page 45, top left inset; book 3 steps 140-144
functions.note: selector levers: p1425 6553 (handle on one side, catch p1426 6641, ring p1051 6539) and p1428 6553 (other side, catch p1427 6641, ring p1050 6539); which lever, and which way, selects which function is inferred from the inset icons, not certain

functions.does: With the same lever the other way (toward the landing-gear symbol), the knob retracts and lowers the landing gear: two small linear actuators fold the main wheels' struts up into the sponsons, and the nose wheels fold too.
functions.source: book 3 page 45, top right inset (arrows on the nose and main wheels)
functions.note: inferred: which parts fold the nose gear

functions.does: With the other lever toward the hoist symbol, the knob winds the rescue winch above the side door, raising or lowering the hook on its string.
functions.source: book 3 page 45, middle right inset (the up-down arrow at the side door)

functions.does: With the other lever toward the helicopter symbol, the knob opens and closes the rear loading ramp under the tail.
functions.source: book 3 page 45, middle left inset (the curved arrow at the ramp)
functions.note: inferred: the ramp's own parts; the two long side beams p1278 and p1399 look like its hinge arms

functions.does: The main rotor's four blades fold back on their hinges for parking, released by a blue lever in the cockpit.
functions.source: book 3 page 45, bottom insets (blue lever, then a blade folding); inferred: how the lever and the blades are connected
functions.note: the blue lever's part wasn't identified

functions.does: The wheels roll freely when the landing gear is down.
